about_the_game:
ARK Axiom is a narrative-driven, turn-based RPG where player choices affect both story and gameplay.

Players abandon one path and embrace another, unlocking varying abilities, altering party dynamics, and reshaping the world itself.

With branching paths, high replayability, and a distinctive cyber-fantasy setting, ARK Axiom offers a fresh take on moral choice in RPGs for narrative-driven audiences to appreciate.

Player choices reshape abilities mid-game:

  • Embrace Truth? Wield a heavy hammer and ice strikes that stun enemies and reveal their weaknesses.

  • Favor Freedom? Gain speed boosts and feather projectiles for agile, environment-based combat.

  • Shield Unity? Summon allies to defend, support, or combine attacks.

  • Seize Control? HARD MODE! High-risk, high-reward abilities. Choosing Control alters the world, the story, and unlocks a special ending.

Each choice affects both combat and exploration. Out-of-battle abilities help with in-game puzzles and location access as we

  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 6000 or better, or Apple M1 GPU)
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
